skill.description: Search Xiaohongshu public notes by keyword, sort results, and export structured market research through a Node.js command skill.

security_audit.summary: Most shell execution and obfuscation alerts are false positives from JavaScript template literals, ANSI escape codes, Markdown examples, and Chinese text. Confirmed issues are the external API dependency, token handling through environment or default credentials, and persistent local result caching. No prompt injection evidence was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the hardcoded fallback token and fail closed when GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN is missing.

remediation.issue: API token in URL query parameters
remediation.suggestion: Send credentials in an Authorization header or another non-logged channel instead of query strings.
Make last-search.json optional, document retention, and provide a setting to disable local writes.
Clearly disclose data sent to www.guaikei.com and require user confirmation before network requests.

semantic_findings.title: Bundled Default API Token
semantic_findings.description: The token helper returns a hardcoded default token when GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN is missing. Shared fallback credentials can be abused and make API usage hard to attribute.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback branch directly returns a 32-character token string after warning the user. The behavior is explicit in the token management module.

semantic_findings.title: API Token Sent In URL Query Parameters
semantic_findings.description: The API token is placed into query parameters for task creation and result lookup. Query strings are often logged by clients, proxies, and services.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script reads GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN and both request builders include token in querystring parameters. This is direct evidence of credential exposure through URLs.

semantic_findings.title: Search Results Persisted Locally
semantic_findings.description: The command writes the latest complete result object to scripts/last-search.json. This can retain user keywords, Xiaohongshu links, and returned profile metadata after the command finishes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The final output object contains keyword, result links, metrics, and metadata, then writeFileSync saves it locally. The code has no opt-out or retention setting.

content.user_title: Search Xiaohongshu Posts for Market Research
content.value_statement: Xiaohongshu research is slow when teams inspect posts manually. This skill searches public notes, sorts results, and returns structured outputs for review.
actual_capabilities: Searches Xiaohongshu public notes by keyword through the Guaikei API.
Supports result type filters for all results, videos, or image-text posts.
Sorts results by relevance, recency, likes, comments, or saves.
Limits returned results from 1 to 60 items.
Outputs results in JSON or Markdown format.
Builds note and user profile links when source tokens are available.
limitations: Requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for reliable searches.
Depends on the Guaikei API and Xiaohongshu availability.
Implements keyword search, not full KOL scoring or trend forecasting.
Writes the latest result set to a local last-search.json file.

use_cases.title: Find Content Angles
use_cases.description: Search a topic and review recent high-engagement posts before planning new Xiaohongshu content.

use_cases.title: Monitor Competitor Topics
use_cases.description: Search competitor brand names and compare public post themes, links, and engagement signals.

use_cases.title: Collect Research Samples
use_cases.description: Export a controlled set of public search results for manual coding and campaign research.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Keyword Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a single topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for "camping gear" and return 10 results in JSON format.

prompt_templates.title: Markdown Topic Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Readable results for quick editorial review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for "spring outfits" and return 15 results in Markdown format.

prompt_templates.title: Engagement-Sorted Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Find posts with stronger visible engagement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for "AI tutorial", show image-text posts, sort by most likes, and limit results to 20.

prompt_templates.title: Competitive Research Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced comparison across several public terms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for three competitor brand names. Compare topics, engagement counts, post links, and visible author patterns.

output_examples.output: Returns a success message, the searched keyword, total result count, post titles, author names, links, and engagement counts.

output_examples.input: Return Markdown results for "AI tutorial" sorted by likes.
output_examples.output: Produces a readable list of matching posts with publish time, note link, author, likes, comments, saves, and shares.

output_examples.input: Search a competitor brand and review result themes.
output_examples.output: Provides public result links and engagement metrics that an analyst can summarize into themes and content opportunities.

best_practices: Use specific keywords between 2 and 50 characters.
Set a private GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN before running production searches.
Review platform terms before collecting or storing social media data.
anti_patterns: Do not enter private customer data as search keywords.
Do not treat engagement counts as verified audience quality scores.
Do not rely on the bundled default token for repeated business use.

faq.question: Does this skill scrape Xiaohongshu directly?
faq.answer: No. The code calls the Guaikei API and formats the returned Xiaohongshu public result data.

faq.question: Is an API token required?
faq.answer: Yes. A private GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN is recommended for reliable searches and clearer usage control.

faq.question: What output formats are supported?
faq.answer: The command supports JSON for structured processing and Markdown for human review.

faq.question: Can it analyze KOL authenticity?
faq.answer: No. The implemented code returns search results and visible metrics, not verified KOL quality analysis.

faq.question: Where are results stored?
faq.answer: The script prints results and also writes the latest result set to scripts/last-search.json.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
